products.name: Aurelia Clasp Handbag
products.description: Embody timeless luxury with our signature Aurelia Handbag. Handcrafted from top-grain rose-blush calfskin leather and finished with bespoke polished gold metal hardware. Featuring an organized interior lined with silk, a zipper pocket, and an adjustable shoulder strap for dual wear.
features: 100% genuine calfskin leather
Soft luxurious silk-blend inner lining
Interiors: 1 phone slot, 1 card drawer, 1 main compartment
Polished 18k gold-plated brass security buckle

reviews.comment: Absolutely mesmerizing handbag! The leather smells divine and the pink shade is perfect.
Stunning design, highly elegant. Good space for cards and makeup essential kits.

products.name: Chevron Quilted Shoulder Bag
products.description: Exude sophistication on every occasion. This shoulder bag features rich, chevron-quilted nappa leather, structured panels, and a convertible golden slide chain strap. The dark metallic finish lends a contemporary edge to classic feminine grace.
features: High density premium structured nappa leather
Multi-way sliding chain strap (shoulder/crossbody)
Interior slide divider with zipped divider wall
Secure magnetic front flap with golden crest monogram

reviews.comment: Perfect addition for dinner dates. The chain feels sturdy and high-quality.

products.name: Sienna Workday Tote
products.description: Designed for the modern, multi-passionate woman. Combining spacious proportions with refined minimalist sensibilities, the Sienna Tote is crafted from premium textured canvas bounded by waterproof protective leather trimming. Easily fits a 14-inch laptop, tablets, and journals.
features: Durable weave canvas & water-resistant polyurethane protection
Accommodates tablets, books, cosmetic pouches, and up to 14" laptops
Double-handle carry with luxurious leather hand protection padding
Stained wood bottom feet studs for damage prevention

reviews.comment: Extremely roomy. I take it to the office and cafes every day.

products.name: Belle Mini Crossbody
products.description: Compact size, grand impressions. The Belle Crossbody is a delicate companion for walks and strolls. Crafted from pebble-textured vegan leather, it includes double secure zip compartments to keep your phone, keys, and lipsticks snug.
features: Pebble grain cruelty-free vegan leather outer
Dual zipper main compartments
Adjustable tactile matching cross-body strap
Lightweight design weighing under 300g

reviews.comment: Sweetest little bag! Soft pink matches all my summer outfits.

products.name: Evelyn Suede Satchel
products.description: Understated modern vintage. Crafted from butter-soft vegan camel suede and trimmed with beautiful rigid saddle leather accents. Features dual compartments, top handles, and a detachable long shoulder belt.
features: Soft luxurious brushed vegan suede microfiber flat
Rigid vegetable tanned trim base detailing
Dual internal secure pockets with heavy metal sliders
Adjustable and detachable matching crossbody strap

products.name: Ophelia Evening Envelope
products.description: Steal the spotlight. This stunning, hand-beaded envelope clutch features delicate blush pink sequins, crystalline glass beads, and ivory pearls carefully woven into premium satin. Comes with a hidden attachable fine chain strap.
features: Hand-sewn crystalline glass beads and sequins
Heavy satin fabric base construction
Hidden detachable 110cm metal chain belt
Beautiful inner card sleeve pocket
